thread:
nadia: Quick check: last test cohort skipped the top banner. Proposing a compact inline 'starter kit' header instead of a wide banner.

ryan: Agree. Inline header that expands into 3 steps feels less ad-like. Keep it collapsed by default.

taylor: Copy idea: "Starter kit: Connect key, run a test request, import a demo app (total ~5 mins)". Action-first and time estimate.

kevin: UI: show 2 thumbnails (Chat demo, Embedding search) + a single CTA "Finish setup". No carousel. Thumbnails need alt text.

nadia: a11y-bot: Accessibility nits: ensure expand button has aria-expanded, thumbnails are tabbable with visible focus, and use aria-live="polite" when announcing step completion. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

ryan: Analytics: events onboarding_header_shown, onboarding_expanded, starterkit_dismissed, step_completed. Persist dismiss per user.

taylor: I'll mock the inline header and a copy variant with "Run a demo in 5 minutes" vs "Get started in 5 minutes" for A/B.

kevin: I'll add the feature flag ff_starterkit_inline and wire persistence API.

nadia: Great. Action owners: taylor mock, kevin infra+flag, ryan analytics, a11y-bot will run quick audit during QA. I'll schedule a 3-person usability readout next week. :sparkles:
